svg.title: Protected token release: 14 of 16 implementation-detail units landed, 1 in progress, 1 open. Row 15 exact committed-original release is in progress; fresh private authorization 15.1 and committed-original verification 15.2 are source-landed, and completion-to-release proof 15.3 is NEXT/open.
svg.desc: Sixteen nonadditive implementation units inside activation step 20. Units 01–14 are source-landed; row 15 is in progress and row 16 remains open. Foundations 01–02 landed 4db227b; 03–06 7713e4c; custody, retention and cold construction 07–09 658c59e; cold planner service 10 d733681. Authorization unit 11 retains 12/12 substeps with evidence f6dd3cb, 0ef6024, b3c9a58, 4b421e2 and 8ac2374; grant detail remains 5/5. Reservation/pending 12 and one-use SQL 13 landed bdaee24 after 4d4091c and dd460ba. Completion/recovery 14 has six source components landed: historical replay, purpose custody, durable recovery, cold service, restricted state route and genuine private response. Library foundations retain adaf15f; the linked ledger supplies complete closure criteria and source commit evidence. Fresh private release authorization 15.1 landed c26c9e783b203f14f11505719af80bea2ad7fc8d; committed-original verification 15.2 landed b7be5cbdf2ef75eda606b025032943dc0812bcb9, bringing row 15 to 2/6 diagnostics and release/handoff detail to 2/11. Row 15 exact committed-original release is amber in progress; 15.3 completion-to-release proof is NEXT/open, queued and not active; row 16 cold handoff is gray open. Group c is 12/12 landed; diagnostic groups 3/5. Activation stays 19/26 and project 34/46. Counts are not effort percentages or runtime verification. No plaintext release or public handoff is claimed. Source is uninstalled, unbuilt, unexecuted and unprovisioned; production acceptance remains 0/6 verified.
